title: TRIALMON safety review console
summary: A one-screen safety review of a synthetic first-in-human multiple ascending dose study, CP-101, at its Cohort 4 (120 mg) data cut with 18 dosed participants. Participant, cohort and study-level flags roll up worst-of into one ranked worklist, beside an eDISH liver plot, QTcF categories, CTCAE lab shifts, adverse events by system organ class, a DLT tally against an illustrative 3+3 rule and a study tier with a what-if. A Start here card inside the app says what each color means. The console flags positions for the medical monitor and the Safety Review Committee; it does not adjudicate cases or make a dose-escalation decision.
try: Click a Participant row in the worklist: the sidebar opens that participant's packet.
Open Liver (eDISH) and click the point in the shaded upper-right box, CP101-014: its liver tests by study day show why it is a potential Hy's Law case.
Switch Lab grading to v5.0 in the sidebar: CP101-013's neutrophil count becomes grade 3 and the AMBER count rises from 7 to 8.
On Study tier, set an indicator to RED: the study tier re-rolls worst-of to RED, and Reset to the feed undoes it.

screenshot.alt: The TRIALMON console in light mode: the Start here card with the meaning of RED, AMBER, watch and GREEN, seven value boxes (overall RED, participants and cohorts RED, study tier AMBER, 5 RED and 7 AMBER flags, 2 watch, 18 dosed participants) and the top of the ranked worklist, with the participant packet for CP101-014 in the sidebar.
screenshot.caption: The console as it opens: the Start here card, the worst-of value boxes and the ranked worklist. Synthetic data.
